about: The demo's script: one idea per beat, 1-2 short sentences. 'en' is the source; add 'fa' (or another language key) per beat for a translated render. 'pause': extra seconds after the beat (room for the picture). Scene ids match video/scenes/<id>.js.

beats.en: This flour weighs two kilos, but our wobbly scale never quite agrees.
Each reading is off by a random wobble of about a quarter kilo.
So Pip weighs it again and again, and averages the readings.
Four readings halve the error; sixteen halve it again: about 0.06.
The error falls like one over root n: the standard error.
But if a draught pushes every reading the same way, half the wobble is shared.
Then averaging stalls: even sixty-four readings stay near 0.18.
Averaging removes each reading's own wobble, not the shared part.
